_about: Application portal + fee for Batch 1 routes (deadlines 2 Nov – 15 Dec 2026). Prepared by Muse 2 Nov 2026; re-checked by Claude on official pages the same day. kind: free | paid | unk. cur/amt feed the fee calculator (amt = fee at the first/typical application; bundle = shared SOPHAS charge).

imperial-pres.portal_label: Imperial online application (via the scheme page)
imperial-pres.fee_note: Imperial states there is no application fee for PhDs (taught master's cost £90). No separate scholarship form: apply for the PhD place and select the President's PhD Scholarship in the funding section; the department then nominates you.
imperial-pres.check: Fee quote from Imperial's postgraduate admissions page (Muse, 2 Nov). The scheme page rendered blank for a live re-read, so dates and stipend come from the board's weekly sweep.

oist-phd.fee_note: Non-refundable, and OIST offers no waivers for personal financial situations. Check a supervisor has room for students before you apply.

sanger-phd.fee_note: Applying to the Sanger costs nothing. If you're selected you then apply to the University of Cambridge, which costs £20 (Cambridge Applicant Portal: apply.postgraduate.study.cam.ac.uk).
sanger-phd.check: Both fee lines confirmed on Sanger's FAQ and Cambridge's fee page (2 Nov 2026).

eth-esop.portal_label: ETH Zurich eApply (from the ESOP page)
eth-esop.fee_note: Per degree programme for applicants with a non-Swiss degree (CHF 50 with a Swiss degree). Not refundable and cannot be waived. No extra ESOP fee: you tick ESOP inside the Master's application and add a thesis pre-proposal.
eth-esop.check: CHF 150 confirmed on ETH's master's how-to-apply page (2 Nov 2026). ESOP's own page confirms the single eApply route.

yenching.fee_note: No application fee is listed in the official instructions. Two academic recommendation letters must come from full or associate professors in your intended field, and English scores must be sent directly by the testing body (IELTS 7.0 minimum).
yenching.check: Portal and requirements read on yenchingacademy.pku.edu.cn/ADMISSIONS.htm (2 Nov 2026). 'No fee' is recorded from the absence of any fee in the official instructions.

clarendon.fee_note: No separate Clarendon form: everyone who applies by the course deadline is considered. Applicants resident in a listed low-income country can have the fee waived, and Bangladesh is on Oxford's list.
clarendon.check: Both amounts and the Bangladesh waiver listing confirmed on ox.ac.uk (2 Nov 2026). Scheme page: ox.ac.uk/clarendon.

emjm-neurasmus.fee_note: No application fee appears in the consortium's guidance. The €4,500 per semester participation cost applies only to self-funded students, not to scholarship applicants. Programme site: neurasmus.u-bordeaux.fr.
emjm-neurasmus.check: Portal and fee as reported by Muse (2 Nov). Claude's live re-read of the platform timed out; the 1 Dec noon deadline is also on third-party listings.

hkpfs.fee: Step 1 free · HK$500 per programme at step 2
hkpfs.fee_note: Step 1: submit the initial application to the Research Grants Council by 12:00 noon HKT on 1 Dec 2026 to get a reference number. Step 2: apply to the universities, quoting it. You can choose up to two programmes at one or two universities, and each university charges its own fee (HK$500 per programme at CityU and PolyU).
hkpfs.check: Two-step process and 'up to two programmes' read on the RGC page; HK$500 per programme read on CityU's HKPFS page (2 Nov 2026).

jhu-phd.fee_note: SOPHAS charges $155 for the first programme and $65 for each additional one, so Hopkins + Emory together cost $220, not $310. A limited number of fee waivers exist and must be requested before you submit. The same fees apply to Harvard Chan.
jhu-phd.check: Fee amounts confirmed on Liaison's SOPHAS help centre; Bloomberg's own FAQ confirms PhD applicants use SOPHAS (2 Nov 2026).

emory-phd.fee_note: All Rollins applications run through SOPHAS. If Hopkins is your first designation, Emory adds only the $65 extra-programme charge.
emory-phd.check: Fee amounts confirmed on Liaison's SOPHAS help centre (2 Nov 2026).

singa.fee_note: Log in and choose 'Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)'. A*STAR's international awards page lists intakes closing 1 June and 1 December.
singa.check: Portal and the 1 Dec / 1 Jun deadlines confirmed on a-star.edu.sg. 'No fee' is from Muse's check; the live page did not state a fee either way.

mps.fee_note: One portal for all four Schools (Biomedical AI, Cognition, Matter to Life, Photonics), open 1 Sep – 1 Dec 2026. Each School has its own requirements page, so read the one for your School.
mps.check: Portal and dates read on maxplanckschools.org (2 Nov 2026). No fee is mentioned anywhere; the Matter to Life page says 'no registration fee'.

euhem.portal_label: University of Oslo (or MCI Innsbruck) application
euhem.fee_note: Apply through Eu-HEM's partner universities, preferably Oslo. Eu-HEM is not an Erasmus Mundus programme and offers no scholarship; non-EEA participation costs are about €9,000 a year.
euhem.check: 'EMJM scholarship is not available for this programme' read on eu-hem.eu FAQ (2 Nov 2026). The €9,000 figure comes from Erasmus University Rotterdam's page as reported by Muse.

gates.fee_note: No separate Gates form: apply to Cambridge and complete the Gates section of the funding part. Gates itself charges nothing. Cambridge fee waivers apply to some applicants automatically; check eligibility in the portal.
gates.check: Fees confirmed on Cambridge's own fee page ('from September 2025'); 8 Dec 2026 / 6 Jan 2027 deadlines confirmed on gatescambridge.org (2 Nov 2026).

cw-shared.fee_note: Two applications are needed: CSC Central, and the UK university for the approved course. The CSC doesn't charge to apply; the university may charge its own course fee. Opens 10 Nov 2026.
cw-shared.check: Portal and 'does not charge' line read on cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk (2 Nov 2026).

emjm-noha.fee_note: Scholarship applications run only 1 Oct – 15 Dec 2026 (23:59 GMT). Candidates must have completed their degree by 15 Dec 2026 to be eligible for the scholarship.
emjm-noha.check: Portal, window and the degree-completion rule read on apply.nohanet.org (2 Nov 2026). No fee is mentioned.

unc-phd.fee_note: The PhD uses the UNC Graduate School application, not SOPHAS. Name at least one and up to five faculty mentors. Fee waivers can be requested through the Graduate School.
unc-phd.check: Deadline 15 Dec 2026, the $95 fee and the mentor rule read on sph.unc.edu/epid/phd (2 Nov 2026).

mbzuai.fee_note: Submit the application, sit the screening exam, then pay. The fee is waived if your screening score is 75% or above, and unpaid applications don't proceed to review.
mbzuai.check: Fee and waiver rule read on mbzuai.ac.ae admissions pages (2 Nov 2026). The 'refunded if you enrol' detail is from Muse and not re-confirmed.

au-sydney.portal_label: Sydney postgraduate research application + RTP form
au-sydney.fee_note: Two steps: apply for admission to the research degree, then complete the separate RTP scholarship form. The A$150 processing fee is non-refundable and covers all your applications within one year. It's waived only if you already hold a full sponsorship letter.
au-sydney.check: A$150 and the 'covers all applications within one year' wording read on sydney.edu.au (2 Nov 2026).

emjm-phid.fee_note: Register on the platform first to get a username and password, then apply. No application fee is mentioned anywhere on the official site. Programme site: masterpublichealthdisasters.eu.
emjm-phid.check: Portal and the 1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026 window checked live by Muse on the official site (2 Nov 2026).

ntu-rss.fee_note: Non-refundable, inclusive of GST. Indicate interest in the NTU Research Scholarship inside the admission application. NTU waives the fee for some listed nationalities; whether Bangladesh is one wasn't confirmed.
ntu-rss.check: S$50 confirmed on NTU's own programme pages ('adjusted to S$50, inclusive of GST'); research-programme figure from NTU's admission guide via Muse.

kaust.fee_note: No separate fellowship application: every admitted student receives the KAUST Fellowship automatically. Round 2 for Fall 2027 closes 3 Jan 2027.
kaust.check: Round 2 deadline (3 Jan 2027) and 'all admitted master's students receive the fully-funded KAUST Fellowship' read on kaust.edu.sa. 'No fee' from Muse's check.

emjm-imim.fee_note: The 2027 call opens 25 November 2026 and closes 4 January 2027. Coordinated by the University of Groningen. Medicine is a listed eligible field.
emjm-imim.check: Deadline conflict resolved: the official IMIM homepage says 'The deadline to submit your application is 04 January 2027' (Groningen's page still shows last year's 5 January).

emory-mph.fee_note: The 5 Jan 2027 priority deadline means the application must be complete AND verified by SOPHAS by then; verification can take up to 10 business days, so submit in mid-December.
emory-mph.check: SOPHAS fees confirmed on Liaison's help centre (2 Nov 2026).

eiffel.portal_label: No student portal: a French institution nominates you
eiffel.fee_note: Only a French institution can submit an Eiffel file, through Campus France, by 6 Jan 2027. Your real application is admission to the institution plus asking it to nominate you. Most internal deadlines fell in Oct–Nov 2026.
eiffel.check: Nomination-only rule and the 6 Jan 2027 institutional deadline from Campus France's programme page (via the board and Muse).

emjm-humres.fee_note: The programme says applicants do not need to pay application fees. Applications go through Iscte's Fénix platform, linked from the page. 15 scholarships per edition; only candidates with a 180-ECTS bachelor's can be admitted.
emjm-humres.check: 'Erasmus Mundus Human Response applicants do not need to pay application fees' and the 7 Jan 2027 close read on humanresponse.eu (2 Nov 2026).

emjm-eph.fee_note: Scholarship round closes 8 Jan 2027 at 13:00 CET; top-ranked candidates are interviewed on 18 Feb. The self-funded round (24 Mar) carries no scholarship.
emjm-eph.check: Portal from the official 2027–29 applicant instructions (europubhealth.org), via Muse. No fee stated.

ista-phd.fee_note: No application fee and no tuition; PhD students are salaried employees. Submit before 14:59 CET on 8 Jan 2027 (the page shows both 14:59 and 15:00). Referee letters are due 12 Jan.
ista-phd.check: 'No application fee is required' and 'January 8, 2027 (3:00 PM CET)' read on ista.ac.at pages (2 Nov 2026).

csc.fee: None for CSC · some universities charge
csc.fee_note: Type A goes through the Chinese Embassy in Dhaka; Type B goes through an individual Chinese university. CSC itself charges nothing, but some universities charge their own portal fee for Type B (around CNY 400–500).
csc.check: From CSC and university guidance via Muse. The 2027 Bangladesh notice isn't published yet.

emjm-idoh.fee_note: Applying enters you for both self-funded and Erasmus Mundus scholarship places. The consortium also nominates some candidates for Eiffel. Window: 1 Dec 2026 – 15 Jan 2027.
emjm-idoh.check: Window (1 Dec 2026 – 15 Jan 2027) read on infectious-diseases-one-health.eu (2 Nov 2026). No fee stated.

hartford-srf.portal_label: Hartford Hospital fellowship page (apply by email/materials)
hartford-srf.fee_note: No portal: send a CV in NIH format, a personal statement and two letters as the page directs. It's a research position, not a scholarship; Hartford can sponsor a J-1 Research Scholar visa.
hartford-srf.check: From the Hartford Hospital / Bone & Joint Institute page via Muse.

reading-intl-phd.fee_note: Apply for a Reading PhD by 15 Jan 2027; your School then nominates one candidate for the studentship. There's no separate scholarship form.
reading-intl-phd.check: Route from Reading's PhD pages via Muse. No fee appears on the pages checked.

hung.fee_note: Two applications: the Tempus portal AND a nomination from the Bangladesh Sending Partner, which is mandatory. 'The entire scholarship application and admission process is free of charge.'
hung.check: No-fee wording from the University of Debrecen's official Stipendium Hungaricum page (via Muse). The 2027/28 call isn't published yet.

mastermind.fee: No scholarship fee · university fee varies
mastermind.fee_note: Apply for admission to a participating Flemish institution (KU Leuven, UAntwerp, Ghent, Hasselt, VUB); it pre-selects you and creates your scholarship file. The admission application may have its own fee (KU Leuven reported at €75–90).
mastermind.check: Route from Study in Flanders via the board and Muse. The 2027–28 terms are under review.

columbia-mph.fee_note: One SOPHAS application covers Columbia, Emory and the US PhDs: the first programme costs $155 and each extra $65.
columbia-mph.check: SOPHAS fees confirmed on Liaison's help centre (2 Nov 2026).

si.portal_label: University Admissions Sweden, then the SI portal
si.fee_note: One SEK 900 fee per semester at universityadmissions.se, however many programmes you choose (up to four SI-eligible ones). The SI scholarship application in February is free but needs your University Admissions number.
si.check: 'You pay one single fee of 900 SEK' read on universityadmissions.se (2 Nov 2026).

emjm-live.fee_note: The scholarship application is part of the MyLIVE file. Open 18 Nov 2026 – 20 Jan 2027 (Lyon time). Clinicians are explicitly welcome.
emjm-live.check: Window confirmed on the board and a listing quoting the official page; no fee stated.

emjm-spacemed.fee_note: Choose the scholarship inside the same form. Includes a motivation video under one minute. Closes 21 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET.
emjm-spacemed.check: No-fee status and dates from the earlier SpaceMed verification on space-med.eu (30 Oct – 1 Nov 2026).

unimelb-mdhs.portal_label: University of Melbourne graduate research application
unimelb-mdhs.fee_note: No separate scholarship form: new applicants are considered automatically. Melbourne charges direct international applicants A$154 per application. Rounds are supervisor-first.
unimelb-mdhs.check: 'All new direct international applicants pay a non-refundable fee of AUD$154 for each application' read on study.unimelb.edu.au (2 Nov 2026). Muse had this as not verified.

nz-waikato.fee_note: Apply to enrol in a doctoral programme, then apply under the Scholarships tab. You need an Offer of Place before the scholarship is considered. Rounds close 31 Jan, 30 Apr, 31 Jul and 31 Oct.
nz-waikato.check: Process from Waikato's pages via Muse; 'no fee' is from secondary guides, not an official fee page.

usra.portal_label: No single portal: USAJobs for federal posts, university career pages for the rest
usra.fee_note: There is no application fee for searching or applying to these posts. Posts are advertised employer by employer (USAJobs for federal posts, university and hospital career pages, NIH institute pages). Costs start only at the visa stage: if ECFMG sponsors your J-1, that is a $370 annual fee, $220 SEVIS and the J-1 visa fee (see the ECFMG J-1 card).
usra.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against ECFMG's EVSP fees page for the sponsorship leg; the route itself has no central portal or fee, so nothing more could be verified.

mayo-rf.portal_label: Mayo Clinic Careers (apply to each post)
mayo-rf.fee_note: These are job applications through Mayo's careers portal. No fee is charged or published. Set job alerts, because posts close fast. The real costs come at the visa stage (see the ECFMG J-1 card).
mayo-rf.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against Mayo Clinic Careers (jobs.mayoclinic.org), as named on the board's card; no fee is stated for employment applications.

ecfmg-j1rs.portal_label: ECFMG EVSP, via MyIntealth (with your host's Training Program Liaison)
ecfmg-j1rs.fee_note: ECFMG's annual application fee is $370 (required every case), plus SEVIS $220 and the J-1 visa application fee, listed at $160 on ECFMG's page. Re-check the visa fee against the State Department before paying. Extra $367 + $200 only for cases needing Department of State review (change of category, exceptional extension). Your host starts the process.
ecfmg-j1rs.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against ECFMG's EVSP Fees page (crawled 18 Apr 2026) and the EVSP Research Scholar checklist; the visa-fee line needs a re-check.

ecfmg.portal_label: MyIntealth (ECFMG) and the FSMB USMLE portal
ecfmg.fee_note: ECFMG certification application $580 (from 1 Apr 2026); Step 1 $695 + $210 overseas surcharge; Step 2 CK $695 + $235; Pathway application (2027 season) $945. Since 12 Jan 2026 international graduates register and pay for the Step exams through FSMB (usmle.fsmb.org); ECFMG still decides eligibility. ERAS and Match fees are separate, and any English-test (OET) fee is not priced here.
ecfmg.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against ECFMG's fee-increase notice (effective 1 Apr 2026), the ECFMG Fees Overview and the 2027 Pathways requirements.

maastricht-gh.portal_label: Studielink, then Maastricht University MyApplication portal
maastricht-gh.fee_note: Register on Studielink (opens 1 Oct 2026), then complete the MyApplication portal. Because your MBBS is from a non-EU/EEA country you pay a €100 handling fee, by the 10 Dec 2026 file deadline. UM does not cover it. The scholarship form itself is free.
maastricht-gh.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against UM's MSc Global Health admission requirements page for 2027-2028 and the NL-High Potential Scholarship page.

maastricht-epi.portal_label: Studielink, then Maastricht University MyApplication portal
maastricht-epi.fee_note: Register on Studielink (opens 1 Oct 2026), then complete the MyApplication portal. Because your MBBS is from a non-EU/EEA country you pay a €100 handling fee, by the 10 Dec 2026 file deadline. UM does not cover it. The scholarship form itself is free. Confirm on UM's 2027-28 participating-programmes list that the full-time Epidemiology variant is eligible.
maastricht-epi.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against UM's MSc Epidemiology admission requirements page for 2027-2028 and the NL-High Potential Scholarship page.

nih-vf.portal_label: No central portal: contact NIH labs directly (OITE: training.nih.gov)
nih-vf.fee_note: NIH's official pages state no application fee, and there is no central application to pay for. Approaching principal investigators and registering with OITE are free. Once a lab selects you, NIH's Division of International Services processes the Visiting Program case and NIH sponsors the J-1 itself, not ECFMG. Government visa fees apply later.
nih-vf.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against NIMH and NIAID training pages and NIH Division of International Services guidance; no fee stated, none found.

emjm-all.portal_label: No single portal: EACEA Erasmus Mundus Catalogue (apply on each programme's site)
emjm-all.fee_note: The catalogue is a directory, not an application portal. Each consortium sets its own fee and the great majority of Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters charge none, but that is not guaranteed. The programme's own site is the only authority. You may apply to at most three programmes per cycle.
emjm-all.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the EACEA Erasmus Mundus Catalogue page; no central fee exists.

usphd.portal_label: SOPHAS (most schools of public health); some use their own portal
usphd.fee_note: SOPHAS charges $155 for the first programme and $65 for each additional one. Some programmes add their own fee. Bangladesh is on SOPHAS's Least Developed Countries list, so you can request the international fee waiver, which covers the $155 first fee only; apply before you submit. Some schools, such as UNC Gillings' PhD, use their own portal.
usphd.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the SOPHAS Fees and Fee Waivers page on Liaison's Applicant Help Center.

kh.portal_label: Knight-Hennessy Scholars application, plus Stanford Graduate Admissions
kh.fee_note: The KHS application is free, stated explicitly on KHS's official page. The separate Stanford graduate programme application costs $125, non-refundable, and KHS cannot waive it. Both applications are required. The 2027 cohort is closed.
kh.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against KHS's Your Applications and Online Application pages and Stanford Graduate Admissions' Application Fee page.

emjm-hygieia.fee_note: No application fee is stated anywhere on the programme's site. Erasmus Mundus applications are usually free, but HYGIEIA's site does not say so, so no claim is made either way. Applications go to the consortium (Lusófona University in Lisbon coordinating, University of Belgrade, University of the Balearic Islands) through the programme site.
emjm-hygieia.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against hygieiamaster.eu (Application Process and Selection pages) and the University of Belgrade Faculty of Pharmacy HYGIEIA 2026/2027 call; fee and 2027 deadline not found.

lshtm-fund.portal_label: LSHTM online application, then the scholarships portal link emailed after you apply
lshtm-fund.fee_note: Two steps. First, apply for a London-based MSc and pay the non-refundable £50 admissions fee. Second, LSHTM emails a link to its scholarship portal where you select 'LSHTM Fund Scholarship'. No separate scholarship fee is stated. Both steps must be done by the scholarship deadline. The 2027-28 page is not published yet; the link is the 2026-27 page.
lshtm-fund.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against LSHTM's 2026-27 Fund Scholarship page and 'How to apply' pages; the 2027-28 deadline was not found.

mext.portal_label: No online portal: Bangladesh Ministry of Education advert, then the Embassy of Japan
mext.fee_note: No fee is stated on the Embassy page or the MEXT information it links to, and no official statement says there is none. The call is advertised each April by the Ministry of Education (moedu.gov.bd) and applications first go to the Ministry, which forwards shortlisted candidates to the Embassy. The Embassy distributes forms to selected candidates, returned in June.
mext.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the Embassy of Japan in Bangladesh MEXT schedule page and basic-requirements PDF; fee not found.

emjm-imagein.portal_label: Université Côte d'Azur eCandidat (link published at opening)
emjm-imagein.fee_note: No application fee, and no statement that there is none, appears on the programme's application page. Applications are entirely online through Université Côte d'Azur's eCandidat platform; the link is published from the opening date. Incomplete or late applications are not considered.
emjm-imagein.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the imAGEin Application & Registration page and the October 2026 brochure; fee not found.

emjm-membiomed.portal_label: Université Côte d'Azur online application (linked from the programme page)
emjm-membiomed.fee_note: No application fee, and no statement that there is none, appears on the programme's pages. The figures sometimes quoted (non-European students €7,900 for the full programme, Europeans €510) are participation costs for self-funded students, not application fees. Applications go to Université Côte d'Azur.
emjm-membiomed.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the MemBioMed programme and Application & Registration pages and the October 2026 brochure; closing date and fee not found.

emjm-other-health.portal_label: No single portal: EACEA Erasmus Mundus Catalogue (apply on each programme's site)
emjm-other-health.fee_note: This card is an umbrella for ten separate programmes (EMMBIOME, EMMaH, NeuroData, NANOMED, S-DISCO, ECT+ One Health, EMOTION, MorphoPHEN, BIOPHAM, MICROSCOM). Fees, where any exist, are stated only on each programme's own site. EACEA tells applicants to visit the programme's site and contact the consortium. Not found at umbrella level.
emjm-other-health.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the EACEA Erasmus Mundus Catalogue page only; none of the ten programme sites was verified in Part 1.

mext-unirec.portal_label: No online portal: apply through the host department (Hamamatsu University School of Medicine)
mext-unirec.fee_note: No MEXT application fee is stated. You must pass Hamamatsu's own graduate-school entrance examination at your own expense, and the examination fee is refunded after October if you are selected as a MEXT recipient. The fee amount is not published on the scholarship page. Other Japanese universities run their own calls.
mext-unirec.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against Hamamatsu University School of Medicine's MEXT University Recommendation page; exam fee amount not found.

gks.portal_label: Study in Korea (NIIED) portal; University Track goes direct to one university
gks.fee_note: No application fee, and no explicit statement that there is none, was found in the NIIED guidelines or the Korean Embassy notice. The Embassy Track is submitted online at studyinkorea.go.kr; the University Track goes directly to one GKS-designated university. You must choose one track only. The 2027 guidelines are not yet published.
gks.check: Checked 3 Nov 2026 against the 2026 GKS-G guidelines on studyinkorea.go.kr, the Korean Embassy in Bangladesh notice and the GKS notice page; no 2027 guidelines and no fee found.

daad-study.portal_label: DAAD Portal (link appears only while a call is running)
daad-study.fee_note: Register on the DAAD Portal and upload documents under 'Attachments'. DAAD states no charge for applying. You must also win admission to a German master's yourself, and DAAD does not pay tuition at the host university.
daad-study.check: DAAD scholarship database entry for the Master's Study Scholarship (Application Procedure and Submitting an Application tabs), 3 Nov 2026; the fee is listed as NOT FOUND, but no charge is mentioned anywhere on the page.

it-dsu.portal_label: No single portal: your region's right-to-study agency (example ER.GO, Emilia-Romagna)
it-dsu.fee_note: DSU is claimed online from the regional agency for the region where your university sits, under that agency's yearly call. Non-EU students also complete pre-enrolment on Universitaly for admission and visa. The family papers (ISEE parificato, legalised and translated) cost money to prepare, but no fee for the claim itself is mentioned.
it-dsu.check: ER.GO guide to the 2026/27 call, UNIMORE and University of Parma fee pages, 3 Nov 2026; no fee found and the 2027/28 deadlines are NOT FOUND (regional calls appear in summer 2027).

bcs51.fee_note: BDT 200 exam fee + BDT 5 data verification fee, paid by Teletalk SMS after the online form. Reduced total of BDT 55 for ethnic minority, disability and third-gender candidates. This cycle is closed, so nothing can be paid or submitted now.
bcs51.check: BPSC site plus BSS and Prothom Alo reports of the 24 Sep 2026 circular, 3 Nov 2026; applications ran 1-25 Oct 2026 and fee payment closed 28 Oct 2026.

turk.fee_note: The official site says applications are received online, free of charge, and that no person or institution may apply on your behalf. Anyone charging a fee to 'handle' an application is not connected to the programme.
turk.check: Turkiye Scholarships official site, How to Apply and programme pages, 3 Nov 2026; the 2027 calendar was NOT FOUND, so the 10 Jan - 20 Feb 2027 dates are unconfirmed.

qatar.fee_note: Process: apply for evaluation on the portal, employer approval, DHP evaluation, then licensing, with a Prometric exam and DataFlow primary-source verification alongside. Current amounts show only inside the portal. Old circulars list QAR 1,000 for a 2-year licence (2014) and QAR 1,100 for the DataFlow package (2016), so do not treat those as current.
qatar.check: DHP Applicant User Manual and Circulars 6/2014 and 25/2016 on dhp.moph.gov.qa, 3 Nov 2026; current fees and any intake window are NOT FOUND.

nus-sph.fee_note: Non-refundable SGD 50 per application. There is no separate scholarship form: you tick 'NUS Research Scholarship' as your source of finance inside the PhD application. A confirmed thesis advisor is mandatory.
nus-sph.check: SSHSPH How to Apply and Aug 2027 intake instructions plus the NUS Graduate School scholarship page, 3 Nov 2026; the Aug 2027 round closed 1 Nov 2026 and no January window was found.

smle.fee_note: Route: DataFlow verification, professional classification in Mumaris+, eligibility number, SMLE at Prometric, then registration (which follows a job in the Kingdom). SCFHS fees show only after login. Prometric says the exam price varies by the country you test in.
smle.check: SCFHS service guides (registration, re-classification, fee refunds) and the Prometric SCFHS FAQ, 3 Nov 2026; fees and any window are NOT FOUND publicly.

plab.fee_note: From 1 April 2026: PLAB 1 £283, PLAB 2 £1,036, full registration with a licence £481 (annual fee also £481). Not included: ECFMG EPIC verification, IELTS or OET, and travel to Manchester for PLAB 2. Fees change every 1 April.
plab.check: GMC fees pages ('Registration fees for doctors explained' and 'How our registration fees have changed'), 3 Nov 2026; there is no single annual deadline, so test dates are booked on GMC Online.

cw.fee_note: The CSC says it does not charge to apply for any scholarship through its online system. You cannot apply directly: a national nominating agency must put you forward. The 2027/28 round closed on 20 Oct 2026 at 16:00 BST.
cw.check: CSC Commonwealth Master's page, the Scholarships and Fellowships listing and the Shared Scholarships page, 3 Nov 2026; the PhD scheme page could not be fetched, so a PhD-specific closing time is NOT FOUND.

ireland.portal_label: Medical Council of Ireland Online Doctors Portal
ireland.fee_note: 2026/27 schedule: first-time application €451, PRES Level 2 exam €352, PRES Level 3 exam €1,500, annual registration €560 (under 3 years on the register) or €665. The Council is raising fees about 10% in 2026 and again in 2027. HSE posts are applied for separately.
